answer.summary: Across the 10 prospect calls, the most important capabilities are clearly security/compliance/access controls and integration breadth: both came up in all 10 calls. Very close behind were operational visibility/run history and pricing predictability (9 of 10), then business-owned workflow design, AI controls, and deployment/testing/phased rollout (8 of 10 each). In other words, prospects care less about “automation” in the abstract and more about whether OrbitFlow can fit their security rules, connect to their systems, show what happened, and avoid nasty commercial surprises.
